admission_measurements: Measured 12 nature nodes, 58 rows, 247 cells. Focused 5-test suite results are recorded in the S36 handoff; opposing provenance never clamps. Memory ceiling and provider capacity remain unmeasured and clinical release is blocked awaiting review.
assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.

Effect present/absent/not_assessed is an explicit applicability input; Active or Resolved executes, NoEpisode is not_applicable with no posterior claim, never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior; unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting pauses for clarification.
All 12 BN-11 distributions were missing (awaiting_experiment_cpt) and are synthetic uniform references here; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.

Full Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; completion required only when phase is Active, absent/not_assessed have no completion requirement, no diagnosis is inferred from an unreviewed total, a missing Dx item never becomes a negative finding, and severity is independent clinician-reviewed mild, moderate or severe, never derived from a total.
Onset (usually within days), medication-timeline, alternative-cause, differential, safety and preference operationalization requires owner review.
Whether review outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.

AirwayConcern Present (stridor/breathing difficulty, laryngeal dystonia) renders a parallel urgent banner from saved structured inputs independently of estimation latency and never as a computed risk percentage; BN-11 AirwayConcern node semantics (estimation context for AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway) are distinct from the parallel banner mechanism.
STATEMENT-11 Table 10 prescribing details are background only and never copied as activation metadata; no dose, route, frequency, active/stopped or free-text fields are collected or accepted.

STATEMENT-11 Quality Measurement Consideration applies: this statement is not appropriate for use as a quality measure or as part of electronic clinical decision support; feasibility, usability, reliability and validity testing would be complicated by small numbers and exclusion criteria.

Candidate 8-field history with airway, episode-phase, association, safety, age-vulnerability, burden, recurrence-need and preference provenance, gate true/false/unknown definitions, and final wording all require review before release.

explicit_graph: Fixed 12-node nature-only graph in BN-11 order (8 roots plus 4 outputs); source_comparison_details lists every retained ordered parent. All proposed_parent metadata is materialized as GIVENs in declared order. Edges are modeler-synthesized review candidates, not established causal facts. BN-11 AirwayConcern node semantics (estimation context) are distinct from the parallel urgent-banner mechanism (saved-input rendering independent of inference).
numerical_examples: examples.json contains one complete independently worked 12-node mathematical reference: ReviewPathway Urgent 0.2/ReviewAcute 0.24/Assess 0.16/PostResolution 0.24/NoRule 0.16 with an Airway/Association transpose guard (swapped gives Urgent 0.6), SafetyFocus ConcernAndBurden 0.105/Concern 0.195/AgeOrBurden 0.336/Routine 0.364 with a Safety/Burden transpose guard (swapped gives 0.07), Continuation NotPost 0.2/Establish 0.2/Need 0.06/Consider 0.18/Stopping 0.36, Regimen ReviewDose 0.3/Assess 0.5/NoReview 0.2. Two opposing projections of the same CPT yield identical posteriors, proving no clamping. This validates math and engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
